task_description: Sprint 7 (final sprint) of the Munder Difflin import plan - Ecosystem Completion. Implements 6 features: SSRF Protection, Trigger System (4 Types), Tool Catalog, Integration Registry + Encrypted Secrets, Skills Discovery + Catalog, and Semantic Memory.

verification.summary: All 1828 tests pass (177 new tests added across 7 test files). All new modules import cleanly. Tests exercise real logic paths with mocks only where subprocess/network calls are needed.

review.notes: 5 non-blocking issues noted: (1) blocking DNS in async safe_resolve, (2) TOCTOU gap in SSRF resolve-then-fetch, (3) hardcoded PBKDF2 salt, (4) unsanitized agent_id in subprocess argv, (5) is_safe_url allows HTTP to localhost on any port. All appropriate for v1 and documented.
